arxiv-2101-08313.title: On-state commutativity of measurements and joint distributions of their outcomes
arxiv-2101-08313.creator: Jan Czajkowski, Alex B. Grilo
arxiv-2101-08313.description: Abstract In this note, we analyze joint probability distributions that arise from outcomes of sequences of quantum measurements performed on sets of quantum states. First, we identify some properties of these distributions that need to be fulfilled to get a classical behavior.

arxiv-2108-07779.title: Appearance based Deep Domain Adaptation for the Classification of Aerial Images
arxiv-2108-07779.creator: Dennis Wittich, Franz Rottensteiner
arxiv-2108-07779.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dennis Wittich, Franz Rottensteiner. This paper addresses domain adaptation for the pixel-wise classification of remotely sensed data using deep neural networks (DNN) as a strategy to reduce the requirements of DNN with respect to the availability of training data. We focus on the setting in which labelled data are only available in a source domain 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}^{S} , but not in a target domain 𝒟 T \mathcal{D}^{T} .

arxiv-2109-11852.title: Full description of Benjamin-Feir instability of Stokes waves in deep water
arxiv-2109-11852.creator: Massimiliano Berti, Alberto Maspero, Paolo Ventura
arxiv-2109-11852.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Massimiliano Berti, Alberto Maspero, Paolo Ventura. Small-amplitude, traveling, space periodic solutions –called Stokes waves– of the 2 dimensional gravity water waves equations in deep water are linearly unstable with respect to long-wave perturbations, as predicted by Benjamin and Feir in 1967. We completely describe the behavior of the four eigenvalues close to zero of the linearized equations at the Stokes wave, as the Floquet exponent is turned on.

arxiv-2110-08056.title: Orbital mixing in few-layer graphene and non-Abelian Berry phase
arxiv-2110-08056.creator: K. Shizuya
arxiv-2110-08056.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by K. Shizuya. In a magnetic field few-layer graphene supports, at the lowest Landau level, a multiplet of zero-mode levels nearly degenerate in orbitals as well as in spins and valleys. Those pseudo-zero-mode (PZM) levels are generally sensitive to interactions and external perturbations, and have a crossing among themselves or with other higher Landau levels when an external field is swept over a certain range.

arxiv-2204-09248.title: Synthetic Target Domain Supervision for Open Retrieval QA Conference: Proceedings of the 44th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 11–15, 2021; Virtual Event, Canada Proceedings of the 44th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and De
arxiv-2204-09248.creator: Revanth Gangi Reddy, Bhavani Iyer, Md Arafat Sultan, Rong Zhang, Avirup Sil, Vittorio Castelli, Radu Florian, Salim Roukos
arxiv-2204-09248.description: Abstract . Neural passage retrieval is a new and promising approach in open retrieval question answering. In this work, we stress-test the Dense Passage Retriever (DPR)—a state-of-the-art (SOTA) open domain neural retrieval model—on closed and specialized target domains such as COVID-19, and find that it lags behind standard BM25 in this important real-world setting.

arxiv-2206-04421.title: Solid NURBS Conforming Scaffolding for Isogeometric Analysis Woodstock ’18: ACM Symposium on Neural Gaze Detection, June 03–05, 2018, Woodstock, NY Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Theory of computation Computational geometry CCS: Mathematics of computing Geometric topology CCS: Compu
arxiv-2206-04421.creator: Stefano Moriconi, Parashkev Nachev, Sébastien Ourselin, M. Jorge Cardoso
arxiv-2206-04421.description: Abstract . This work introduces a scaffolding framework to compactly parametrise solid structures with conforming NURBS elements for isogeometric analysis. A novel formulation introduces a topological, geometrical and parametric subdivision of the space in a minimal plurality of conforming vectorial elements. These determine a multi-compartmental scaffolding for arbitrary branching patterns.

arxiv-2304-04325.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Object Segmentation from Unlabeled RGB-D Videos
arxiv-2304-04325.creator: Shiyang Lu, Yunfu Deng, Abdeslam Boularias, Kostas Bekris
arxiv-2304-04325.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shiyang Lu, Yunfu Deng, Abdeslam Boularias, Kostas Bekris. This work proposes a self-supervised learning system for segmenting rigid objects in RGB images. The proposed pipeline is trained on unlabeled RGB-D videos of static objects, which can be captured with a camera carried by a mobile robot. A key feature of the self-supervised training process is a graph-matching algorithm that operates on the over-segmentation output of the point cloud that is reconstructed from each video.

arxiv-2310-11917.title: A Benchmark for Semi-Inductive Link Prediction in Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2310-11917.creator: Adrian Kochsiek, Rainer Gemulla
arxiv-2310-11917.description: Abstract Semi-inductive link prediction (LP) in knowledge graphs (KG) is the task of predicting facts for new, previously unseen entities based on context information. Although new entities can be integrated by retraining the model from scratch in principle, such an approach is infeasible for large-scale KGs, where retraining is expensive and new entities may arise frequently.

arxiv-2412-10379.title: Free Topological Mal’tsev Algebras
arxiv-2412-10379.creator: Ol’ga V. Sipacheva, Aleksandr A. Solonkov
arxiv-2412-10379.description: Abstract . A brief introduction to universal algebra and the theory of topological algebras, their varieties, and free topological algebras is presented. Free topological Mal’tsev algebras are studied. Their properties, relationship with topological groups and heaps, and the problem of direct limit decomposition are considered.

arxiv-2508-00828.title: Finance Agent Benchmark: Benchmarking LLMs on Real-world Financial Research Tasks
arxiv-2508-00828.creator: Antoine Bigeard, Rayan Krishnan, Shirley Wu, Langston Nashold
arxiv-2508-00828.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Antoine Bigeard, Rayan Krishnan, Shirley Wu, Langston Nashold. Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology has emerged as a transformative force in financial analysis and the finance industry, though significant questions remain about the full capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) agents in this domain. We present the Finance Agent Benchmark, featuring challenging and diverse real-world finance research problems which require LLMs to perform complex analysis with the use of of recent SEC filings.

arxiv-2508-05742.title: The Consequences of Rubin Observatory Time-Domain Survey Design and Host-Galaxy Contamination on the Identification of Binary Supermassive Black Holes Journal: ApJ astroML ( Vanderplas et al. 2012 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , NumPy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , LMFits ( Newville et al. 2014
arxiv-2508-05742.creator: Megan C. Davis, Jonathan R. Trump, Maria Charisi, Jessie C. Runnoe, W. N. Brandt, Kaylee E. Grace, London E. Willson
arxiv-2508-05742.description: Abstract Binary supermassive black holes (SMBHs) are consequences of galaxy mergers and dominate the low-frequency gravitational wave background. Finding binary SMBHs in existing time-domain observations has proven difficult, as their periodic, electromagnetic signals can be confused with the natural variability of single quasars.

arxiv-2508-12113.title: Jacobian Ideals of Hyperplane Arrangements and their Graded Betti Numbers Thanks: Migliore was partially supported by Simons Foundation grant #839618, Thanks: Nagel was partially supported by Simons Foundation grant #636513
arxiv-2508-12113.creator: Juan C. Migliore, Uwe Nagel
arxiv-2508-12113.description: Abstract . A hyperplane arrangement 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is said to be free if the corresponding Jacobian ideal J 𝒜 J_{\mathcal{A}} is Cohen-Macaulay. In particular, if 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is free then J 𝒜 J_{\mathcal{A}} is unmixed (i.e. equidimensional). Freeness is an important property, yet its presence is not well understood.

arxiv-2510-06911.title: LLM-Assisted Modeling of Semantic Web-Enabled Multi-Agents Systems with AJAN
arxiv-2510-06911.creator: Hacane Hechehouche, André Antakli, Matthias Klusch
arxiv-2510-06911.description: Abstract There are many established semantic Web standards for implementing multi-agent driven applications. The AJAN framework allows to engineer multi-agent systems based on these standards. In particular, agent knowledge is represented in RDF/RDFS and OWL, while agent behavior models are defined with Behavior Trees and SPARQL to access and manipulate this knowledge.

arxiv-2510-25273.title: Adapting Small Language Models to Low-Resource Domains: A Case Study in Hindi Tourism QA
arxiv-2510-25273.creator: Sandipan Majhi, Paheli Bhattacharya
arxiv-2510-25273.description: Abstract Domain-specific question answering in low-resource languages faces two key challenges: scarcity of annotated datasets and limited domain knowledge in general-purpose language models. In this work, we present a multi-stage finetuning strategy to adapt lightweight language models to the Hindi tourism domain by leveraging both original and synthetic training data.

arxiv-2601-22152.title: Cobordism and Concordance of Surfaces in 4-Manifolds
arxiv-2601-22152.creator: Simeon Hellsten
arxiv-2601-22152.description: Abstract . We show that two properly embedded compact surfaces in an orientable 4-manifold are cobordant if and only if they are ℤ / 2 \mathbb{Z}/2 -homologous and either the 4-manifold has boundary or the surfaces have the same normal Euler number.

pmc-10541168.creator: Christopher R Razavi, Tom Wang
pmc-10541168.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). issue aims to inform readers on how to best equip their office to safely and effectively offer these services, while providing an overview of the types of procedures that can be well‐suited for the office‐based setting. We have invited experts in the field to discuss the merits and value of office‐based procedures in FPRS, while highlighting precautions and patient selection considerations that are necessary to provide high‐level care outside of the operating room.

pmc-10735510.title: BIOPSYCHOSOCIAL DETERMINANTS OF COGNITIVE FUNCTION AMONG BLACK OLDER ADULTS
pmc-10735510.creator: Amy Thierry
pmc-10735510.description: Black older adults in the United States have twice the risk of being diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias than their white counterparts. However, there remains a gap in knowledge of which factors may contribute to this disparity as well as mechanisms that either increase or decrease risk for poor cognitive outcomes, specifically in older Black adults.

pmc-11371704.title: The effect of the housing crisis in the Alabama Black Belt on respiratory health
pmc-11371704.creator: Sharlene D. Newman, Aylin Akca Sumengen, Michael Rasbury, Steven McDaniel
pmc-11371704.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThere is a growing housing crisis in rural America with homelessness growing in addition to a growing number of substandard homes due to an inability to afford the costs of repair and maintenance. The goal of the current study was to assess the housing concerns in rural Alabama Black Belt communities which are often understudied and the relationship between housing quality and respiratory health.MethodsA semi-random sampling of five Black Belt counties was conducted to obtain a sample of 253 rural households.

pmc-11436784.title: Development and validation of a survey instrument for reusable sanitary products toward sustainable menstrual hygiene
pmc-11436784.creator: Vysakh Kani Kolil, Krishnashree Achuthan
pmc-11436784.description: The predominant use of disposable, non-organic menstrual products has significant environmental impacts due to waste and resource depletion. Concerns over the environmental, economic, and health implications of menstrual hygiene management (MHM) have highlighted the need to explore sustainable options like reusable sanitary pads (RSPs).

pmc-11454252.creator: Uma Datta Gupta, Parinitha Prasad, Pwint P Hlaing, Kalpana Panigrahi, Zewge Deribe
pmc-11454252.description: Disclosure: U.D. Gupta: None. P. Prasad: None. P.P. Hlaing: None. K. Panigrahi: None. Z. Over the last two years, our investigations into polysubstance abuse patients have revealed variations in mortality risks, particularly associated with hypoglycemia.

pmc-11690283.title: AGE-FRIENDLY UNIVERSITY IN PRACTICE: DEVELOPING AN AGE INCLUSIVITY MICRO-CREDENTIAL PROGRAM
pmc-11690283.creator: Serena Hasworth
pmc-11690283.description: This session will highlight findings from PSU’s “Age-Friendly University Campus Report” (Silverstein et al., 2021) and provide an overview of the activities to improve age-friendliness through the Better with Age Initiative, a program that invests in students pursuing career pathways in aging and faculty conducting aging-related research.

pmc-13108872.title: Coherent cross-modal generation of synthetic biomedical data to advance multimodal precision medicine
pmc-13108872.creator: Raffaele Marchesi, Nicolò Lazzaro, Walter Endrizzi, Gianluca Leonardi, Matteo Pozzi, Flavio Ragni, Stefano Bovo, Monica Moroni, Venet Osmani, Giuseppe Jurman
pmc-13108872.description: Integration of multimodal, multi-omics data is critical for advancing precision medicine, yet its application is frequently limited by incomplete datasets where one or more modalities are missing. To address this challenge, we developed a generative framework capable of synthesizing any missing modality from an arbitrary subset of available modalities.

pmc-13554846.title: Pulmonary Embolism as the Initial Presentation of Klippel-Trénaunay Syndrome
pmc-13554846.creator: Ahmed Al Ghazawy, Shriya Bavishi, Akhilesh Jain, Joseph Ingrassia
pmc-13554846.description: BackgroundCongenital vascular malformations are an under-recognized cause of venous thromboembolism in young adults, and their early identification carries important management implications.Case SummaryA 23-year-old man presented with intermediate-high risk pulmonary embolism (PE) and right ventricular dysfunction in the context of lifelong unilateral lower extremity varicosities. After classification by the PE response team, catheter-directed thrombolysis with EKOS ultrasound-assisted catheters achieved hemodynamic stabilization.
